## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag breaks the project's flag convention because it does not read an `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment variable, so CI cannot set it. That should be fixed; no other defects were found in the exclusion logic or its tests.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag. `collect()` uses it to skip files whose base name matches any of the patterns, and it logs each skipped path. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds parser, collection and end-to-end archive tests, and adds a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'`, the setting is ignored, because the default is the fixed list `default=[]`. That breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that pass options through the environment cannot exclude files and will archive everything. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choosing and documenting a separator for multiple patterns, and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` with an environment-set case.
